style: Polished semi-realistic digital illustration for a premium vertical explainer reel: warm cinematic lighting, soft cel shading, clean confident linework, rich but natural colours, detailed believable background, gentle depth of field. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs with writing, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.

assets.name: panda-and-friend
assets.prompt: A calm Beijing hutong street at golden hour. On the LEFT stands a tall, slim young man (full body, head to shoes), short black hair, teal jacket, dark trousers, facing the viewer, his face strongly privacy-blurred and featureless. On the RIGHT stands Aobao the panda exactly as in the first reference image, full body, clearly shorter: the top of Aobao's head reaches only the man's chest. Both face the viewer. Leave generous empty sky and wall space in the upper third. Both figures stand in the lower two thirds with a small gap between them. Aobao stays a flat vector mascot with thick black outlines inside the illustrated street.

assets.name: panda-summer
assets.prompt: The same hutong street as in the second reference image on a hot sunny summer day: bright blue sky, warm sunlight, green leaves. Only Aobao the panda (exactly as the first reference, flat vector, thick outline, red neckerchief) stands in the centre, full body, happy in the heat, wearing small dark sunglasses pushed up on the head. Warm golden colours.

assets.name: panda-winter
assets.prompt: The same hutong street as in the second reference image in winter: heavy snowfall, snow on roofs and the street, cold blue light, grey sky. Only Aobao the panda (exactly as the first reference: same face, closed smiling eyes, thick outline, red neckerchief) stands in the same spot, full body, shivering, wearing a knitted blue winter hat and a small puffer coat open at the neck so the red neckerchief stays visible. Cold blue colours.

assets.name: notebook-desk
assets.prompt: Top-down view of an open notebook lying on a warm wooden desk, the notebook pages completely blank and clean, a cup of green tea and a pen beside it, soft morning window light with gentle shadows. The blank notebook fills the centre of the frame.

assets.name: icon-cold
assets.prompt: A single glossy 3D clay-style icon of a thermometer with a low blue level and a small snowflake beside it, centred on a plain pure white background, soft studio lighting, subtle soft shadow, cute rounded proportions.

assets.name: icon-warm
assets.prompt: A single glossy 3D clay-style icon of a thermometer with a high red level and a small sun beside it, isolated and centred on a plain pure white background that fills the whole square image edge to edge (no room, no card, no frame, no scenery), soft studio lighting, subtle soft shadow, cute rounded proportions.
